headline: 21,900 digital arrest complaints registered till Sept: MHA to SC
caption:
Digital arrest fraud complaints MHA Supreme Court 😳

In cases mein ₹647 crore se zyada ki raqam shamil hai.

headline: BADA PLAN! · Nadda ji ka Chemical Park master plan
caption:
JP Nadda Chemical Park scheme: India ka 2040 tak $1 trillion chemical market ka target 🇮🇳

Modi sarkar ka focus saaf hai: Make in India, naye jobs aur bada manufacturing hub. Opposition sirf sawal uthata hai, NDA kaam karke dikhata hai.
